rv.q: I'll admit that Waitress is in my top ten shows of all time so I may be biased, but this is a flawless production.
Everything about this Tony-nominated musical brought so much joy and happiness into my life.
A slice of pure musical heaven has landed in the Live Music Capital of the World.

cn.t: Critics praise "Waitress" as a heartfelt musical triumph, highlighting Sara Bareilles' acclaimed pop-rock score and strong performances that deliver both emotional resonance and crowd-pleasing charm.
